description: This PHP source file defines the SugarFieldHtml class, a component of the SuiteCRM platform extending SugarFieldBase. It provides methods for rendering HTML fields in various views (detail, edit, search) with HTML sanitization.

classes.name: SugarFieldHtml
classes.description: A class representing an HTML field type within the SuiteCRM system, handling sanitization and rendering of HTML content in different views.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the HTML field for the detail view, sanitizing input and applying the Smarty template.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the HTML field for the edit view, sanitizing input and applying the Smarty template.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the HTML field for the search view, sanitizing input and applying the Smarty template.

methods.name: getVardefValue
methods.description: Retrieves and processes the vardef value, applying encoding conversion.
